title: WPSS/152/2007 of KUNWAR SINGH PUNA Vs STATE and ORS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 152 of 2007
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
 Heard Sri Vinay Upadhyay, learned
counsel for the petitioner.
By means of this writ petition, the
petitioner has sought quashing of
termination order dated 17.08.1982.
The writ petition suffers from
unexplained delay and laches. This court
directed the petitioner on 13.02.2007 to file
supplementary affidavit as to how this writ
petition is maintainable after 24 years of
delay. The explanation given in the
supplementary affidavit filed with
Application No. 868 of 2008 does not
disclose any sufficient reason explaining the
laches of 24 years in filing the writ petition
challenging the termination order dated
17.08.1982.
The writ petition is dismissed in
limine.
08.05.2008 (P.C.P., J.)
NS
